title: Taiwanese Student Association (TSA)
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) at UC Santa Cruz — known in Chinese as 臺灣同學會 — is a non-profit cultural student club at the University of California, Santa Cruz. The organization is dedicated to providing a welcoming environment for overseas Taiwanese students as well as any student interested in Taiwanese culture, and is officially registered in the UCSC Get Involved club directory under the Cultural Identity category.

The TSA hosts a range of events throughout the academic year designed to bring students together around shared cultural interests. Programming has included social events such as Casino Night at the Fireside Lounge, reflecting the club’s emphasis on community building and fun. The organization maintains active social media presences on both Instagram (@ucsc_tsa) and Facebook (UCSC TSA), which serve as its primary channels for event announcements and member engagement.

No founding year could be confirmed from first-party sources. No dedicated organizational website or Linktree was identified; the university’s Get Involved directory at getinvolved.ucsc.edu and the club’s Instagram and Facebook pages are the primary first-party sources.
